{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Fix: revenue is string with commas — parse to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
df = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# DO NOT remove refunded orders — the population is ALL new customers reached via paid search, regardless of status
# Only filter by customer_segment and channel
filtered_df = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (df['channel'] == 'paid_search')]

# Compute conversion rate: fraction of converted == 1
n_total = len(filtered_df)
n_converted = filtered_df['converted'].sum()
conversion_rate = n_converted / n_total if n_total > 0 else 0

print(f"Total new customers via paid_search (including refunded): {n_total}")
print(f"Converted: {n_converted}")
print(f"Conversion rate: {conversion_rate}")

# Check for any unexpected values
print(f"Unique converted values in filtered group: {filtered_df['converted'].unique()}")"}
